title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 37a. Calls on the European Court of Auditors to carry out an in-depth audit of the funds allocated to the LIFE programme, in order to assess their effectiveness, their cost-benefit ratio and their genuine added value for the EU’s environmental objectives;
